Use a data-forward, technical tone throughout. All figures referenced (figure_1.jpg, figure_2.jpg, figure_3.jpg) should be placed on their corresponding slides where available. Do not fabricate any data not found in source_brief.md.

- **Layout**: Top-bottom split
- **Title**: A New Metric: 50% Task-Completion Time Horizon
- **Content**: 
  - (1) Create diverse task suite of 170 tasks
  - (2) Measure human timing and AI success rates
  - (3) Fit logistic model to find the task duration at which AI succeeds 50% of the time.

- **Layout**: Single column centered with structured table

- **Content**: 
  - HCAST (97 tasks, 1 min–30 hrs)
  - RE-Bench (7 difficult ML research engineering tasks, all 8 hrs)
  - SWAA (66 short single-step tasks, 1 sec–30 sec)

- **Title**: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Error Recovery Drive Time Horizon Growth
- **Content**: 
  - Drivers: Improved logical reasoning, better tool use, greater reliability/self-awareness, ability to adapt to mistakes.
  - Limitations: Performance is much lower on less structured "messier" tasks.

- **Title**: Extrapolation Predicts Month-Long Task Automation by 2028–2031
- **Content**: 
  - AI reaches >1 month time horizon (167 work hours) between mid-2028 and mid-2031.
  - 2023–2025 growth rate is ~20% faster than 2019–2025 rate.
  - Caveats: External validity to real-world job distributions remains an open question.

- **Layout**: Single column centered
- **Title**: Takeaways: Exponential Autonomous Capability Growth Demands Proactive Safety Governance
- **Content**: 
  - 1. 50% time horizon is robust (R²=0.97 over 6 years).
  - 2. Doubling every ~7 months with possible acceleration since 2024.
